subject.title: fix(mattermost): bound websocket handshake waits at 30s

question: Should Mattermost adopt an unconditional 30-second WebSocket upgrade deadline, accepting that slower handshakes will be aborted and retried?
rationale: The implementation and proof establish that the deadline restores reconnect progress, but choosing the fixed fail-closed threshold is an availability and compatibility policy decision that tests cannot settle.

options.title: Approve the 30-second deadline
options.body: Accept the Slack/CDP-aligned plugin-local threshold and merge without adding another config surface.

options.title: Choose a different fixed threshold
options.body: Ask the contributor to update the plugin-local constant and proof to an owner-approved duration before merge.

options.title: Pause for deployment evidence
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers have enough Mattermost or proxy latency evidence to choose a safe default.

recommendation.title: Approve the 30-second deadline
recommendation.body: Accept the Slack/CDP-aligned plugin-local threshold and merge without adding another config surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work owns the Mattermost reconnect behavior whose availability semantics this deadline changes.
